protocol.role: new diagnostic confirmation conditional on known simulation DGP and supplied real covariates; not external validation or a deployable policy comparison
protocol.test_endpoint: known-p expected Brier on fixed test X; original hidden training outcomes discarded after state generation
protocol.family: same frozen family and empirical q/B/anchor across paired arms, from broad history; same as supplement_v2
protocol.oracle_benchmark: Choose family argmin on bank A mean loss and evaluate on independent bank B; reverse and average. Knows true DGP probabilities and test X/probabilities. Not a deployable method or exact H_pre. Family is identical to operational policies.
protocol.family_definition: 4 dataset/DGP cells x 2 arms x 3 endpoints
protocol.inference: paired outer-state means, two-sided Student t, Holm over24, Bonferroni simultaneous intervals over24; banks and label draws are not independent observational units
protocol.bounds: E[G_crossfit] <= H_pre <= E[plugin_pre_gain] for fixed state; finite sample observed estimates need not preserve all expectation inequalities. post-minus-crossfit includes selector simulation error, not pure foresight advantage.
protocol.optimizer: existing l2=.45 logistic objective and BFGS; retry non-success once from previous solution with maxiter300; all fits require finite parameters/objective and gradient_inf<=1e-4; record all non-success and retry counts
protocol.stopping: 32 outer states per cell, 64 draws per bank; no outcome-dependent additions, no pooling with existing registered studies

engineering.purpose: test shape/gradient/timing; excluded from all reported estimates
